item.title: Birmingham City Council Imposes Temporary Freeze on Data Centers
item.description: By Javacia Harris Bowser | The Birmingham Times The Birmingham City Council has voted to pause development of new large-scale data centers, as city leaders work to draft regulations. On Tuesday, March 3, the Council unanimously approved a 180-day moratorium on applications for new or expanding hyperscale data centers. City leaders stressed that the moratorium […]

item.title: U.S. Coast Guard to Acquire Vacant Birmingham-Southern College Campus
